name: Chise
source:
A rogue whose judgmental nature masks a deep desire to protect people. She’s searching for a hero, but years of joining parties with common farm boys, runaway princesses, and young men with spiky hair have gotten her nowhere.

[From [url=https://visualnoveler.com/ascendant-hearts]official website[/url]]
